question: Should an omitted OpenShell workspace preserve the existing ambient `OPENSHELL_WORKSPACE` behavior, or should upgrades intentionally force all existing plugin instances to the `default` workspace?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes a currently available workspace-selection path for users without a matching persisted configuration, so only maintainers can choose the compatibility contract.

options.title: Preserve ambient upgrades
options.body: Keep workspace unset unless configured explicitly, while making configured workspace selection deterministic across lifecycle and SSH paths.

options.title: Adopt an explicit breaking reset
options.body: Force `default` for omitted configuration, but document the upgrade break and provide a clear migration or recovery path for existing ambient-workspace users.

recommendation.title: Preserve ambient upgrades
recommendation.body: Keep workspace unset unless configured explicitly, while making configured workspace selection deterministic across lifecycle and SSH paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The original feature implementation owns the lifecycle-to-SSH design that the compatibility choice affects.
